sourceOfTruth: Native ConduitBuild liquid module, Conduit.leaks, open forward tile and native Puddles.get; RepairPointBuild.target/strength/rotation; RepairTowerBuild.targets/warmup; RepairBeamWeapon.HealBeamMount.target/strength. Presentation never transfers liquid, creates puddles, advances native heal state or applies healing.
liquid: Colored curved outflow, moving droplets and expanding surface ripples at genuinely open ordinary conduit ends; native puddle silhouette/amount drives the surface pool. Native liquid-floor receivers also show outflow, matching native absorption/reaction without fabricating a ground puddle. Armored/reinforced no-leak conduits, connected pipes and solid-blocked ends cannot generate an outflow. Residual native puddles remain visible after a pipe empties. Neighbor puddles are deduplicated by native entity identity. Space/boiling liquids do not fabricate ground pools.
healing: Actual repair turret/point target and strength produce a visible beam from the raised native building muzzle to the target's real XYZ pose. Unit repair-beam mounts use real unit orientation and mount offset. Native repair towers emit an expanding range pulse and target pulses only while the native tower is healing. Existing native liquid/heal colors retained.
visibility: Completed geometry submits through the existing bounded streaming renderer. Independent span frustum culling allows beams with off-screen endpoints. Native fog clips beam spans and hides undiscovered sources/puddles. Minimum screen width makes a distant active healing beam readable. Frozen Time.time freezes flow/pulse animation during pause.
performance: Candidate buildings cached from the renderer's canonical placed-building registry, refreshed on world identity/tile-change generation. Only native support families are retained. Per-frame emitted spans/disks/droplets are capped at 24000. No per-building or per-puddle GPU allocations. Cached puddle references are pruned on removal or world change.
multiplayer: SupportEffectsState captures authoritative native healing identities, mount, strength, rotation and pulse progress. A bounded fixed-record codec carries at most 4096 effects with exact payload-size and finite-value validation. Online clients use this visual snapshot exclusively and resolve endpoints through their current XYZ pose replicas; native client target-selection guesses cannot fabricate beams. Native puddles retain their existing built-in replication. Empty snapshots, world changes and the network disconnect lifecycle clear healing visuals; unchanged active effects stay valid when the transport suppresses duplicate snapshots.
verificationPlan: Native isolated fixtures leak ordinary water conduit into real native puddle; connected, blocked and armored pipes do not emit; drain keeps native puddle; removal clears jet. Native RepairPoint/RepairTurret updateTile increases actual target HP and produces XYZ beam; unpowered/absent target removes it; native repair tower and unit repair mount are covered. Camera render verifies actual GPU submissions and immutable native state, with screenshot before owned-fixture cleanup.
knownLimits: Support presentation follows native healing selection/range; healing balance and acquisition are unchanged.
Modded support blocks outside the native inheritance families need their own adapter.
